body.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), the fully interacted estimator satisfies \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{Lin},n}-\tau_n)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,s^2)\). Its residual-Neyman variance based on \(\widehat u_n\) yields an asymptotically conservative Wald interval; coverage is asymptotically exact when \(u_n-s_n^2\to0\).
body.justification: Full interactions remove the clipped covariate component only after terminal slope consistency and limiting residual independence have been established under the stopped design.
body.gap: Lin proves this Gaussian adjustment under complete randomization, and Li--Ding and Zhao--Ding prove related cancellation under uniform constrained designs, not path-selected PSRR.
body.consumer: Applied analysts can use standard fully interacted software and robust residual variance after an original PSRR allocation.
